GLS.feature.pf2e-aoe.title: PF2e Spellglass Areas
GLS.feature.pf2e-aoe.hint: Replaces PF2e Region templates, token emanations, and auras with translucent, damage-aware WebGL areas, integrated labels, and configurable warning zones.
GLAOE.Settings.MotionTier.Name: Area motion
GLAOE.Settings.MotionTier.Hint: How much area effects animate on your screen. This is a client preference and does not change another player's view.
GLAOE.Settings.MaxConcurrent.Name: Maximum rendered areas
GLAOE.Settings.MaxConcurrent.Hint: The most Spellglass Regions and token auras rendered on your client at once. Additional areas keep their native Foundry or PF2e representation.
GLAOE.Settings.StyleDefaults.Name: Archetype colors
GLAOE.Settings.StyleDefaults.Label: Configure archetype colors
GLAOE.Settings.StyleDefaults.Hint: Set the world-default color for every built-in material, Generic area, and Warning Zone.
GLAOE.StyleDefaults.Title: Spellglass Archetype Colors
GLAOE.StyleDefaults.Intro: These are world defaults shared by the table. A GM can still override the archetype, color, and centered label on an individual Region.
GLAOE.RegionStyle.ArchetypeHint: Automatic uses the spell's traits and damage type. Generic is a plain color field; Warning is a boss-attack telegraph.
GLAOE.RegionStyle.ColorHint: Enable the override to replace this Region's world-default archetype color.
GLAOE.RegionStyle.Label: Centered label
GLAOE.RegionStyle.LabelHint: Player-visible text projected at the visual center. Item templates default to their source name; clear and save to hide it. Maximum 80 characters.
GLAOE.Creator.Title: Create Spellglass Area
GLAOE.Creator.Intro: Configure an area, then move it over the scene and click to place it. Mouse-wheel rotation is available for cones, lines, and squares.
GLAOE.Creator.Name: Region name
GLAOE.Creator.PlacementHint: Emanations attach to exactly one selected token. Other shapes are placed with the cursor. Existing areas can be edited from their normal Region configuration sheet.
GLAOE.Creator.ClickToPlace: Move the Spellglass area into position, then left-click to place it. Right-click or Escape cancels.
GLAOE.Creator.CanvasRequired: Open a Scene before creating a Spellglass area.
GLAOE.Creator.PermissionRequired: You do not have permission to create Regions in this Scene.
GLAOE.Creator.SelectOneToken: Select exactly one token before creating an emanation.
GLAOE.Creator.EmanationUnavailable: This Foundry version cannot create token-attached emanations.
GLAOE.Creator.DialogUnavailable: The Spellglass creator requires Foundry VTT v14.
GLAOE.Creator.Failed: Could not place the Spellglass area: {message}
GLAOE.RegionStyle.ModeHint: Automatic uses structured PF2e evidence. Native restores Foundry's presentation for this Region.
GLAOE.RegionStyle.ProfileHint: Profiles remain linked until their settings are detached into custom overrides.
GLAOE.RegionStyle.ColorHintV2: Optional body palette override. Function structure and tactical coverage remain unchanged.
GLAOE.RegionStyle.LabelHintV2: Inherited labels use the originating item, spell, feature, aura, or Region name. Hidden never falls back.
GLAOE.Settings.Intensity.Name: Spellglass intensity
GLAOE.Settings.Intensity.Hint: World-wide spectacle strength. Tactical boundaries and coverage never change.
GLAOE.Settings.Quality.Name: Spellglass quality
GLAOE.Settings.Quality.Hint: Automatic adapts spectacle to frame time. Explicit tiers preserve tactical structure while limiting decoration.
GLAOE.Settings.Profiles.Name: Spellglass profiles
GLAOE.Settings.Profiles.Label: Manage world profiles
GLAOE.Settings.Profiles.Hint: Create reusable compositional profiles for Regions and effects.
GLAOE.Profiles.Title: Spellglass World Profiles
GLAOE.Profiles.Intro: World profiles are live references. Regions using one update when it changes; duplicate or detach when an effect needs an independent copy.
GLAOE.Profiles.InUse: This profile is still referenced by {count} Regions. Reassign or detach them before deleting it.
GLAOE.Profiles.ImportFailed: The selected profile file is invalid.
GLAOE.Migration.Title: Upgrade Spellglass presentations
GLAOE.Migration.Summary: {affected} legacy Regions are ready to upgrade. {warnings} validation warnings were found.
GLAOE.Migration.BackupHint: A complete JSON backup downloads before any Scene is changed. Migration proceeds Scene by Scene and stops on the first failure.
GLAOE.Migration.Failed: Spellglass migration stopped after {count} Regions. The downloaded backup contains every original value.
GLAOE.Scene.NativeHint: Disable Spellglass rendering for every Region and aura in this Scene. Foundry and PF2e visuals are restored immediately.
